Any admin can store a malicious HTML payload that executes in every authenticated user's browser viewing that graph type. ### CVSS `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N` — **4.8 Medium** ### Details ```php // graphs.inc.php:194 echo LibrenmsConfig::get('graph_descr.' . $vars['type']); ``` ### PoC ``` PUT /settings/graph_descr.device_processor {"value": ""} GET /graphs?type=device_processor → ``` ### Fix ```php echo htmlspecialchars(LibrenmsConfig::get('graph_descr.' . $vars['type']), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8'); ``` ### Prerequisite Admin session to set the config value.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-7cj5-v4pp-v632", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-08-18T21:17:20Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-7cj5-v4pp-v632", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-7cj5-v4pp-v632"}], "nvd_published_at": null, "published_at": "2026-08-18T21:17:20Z", "references": ["https://github.com/librenms/librenms/security/advisories/GHSA-7cj5-v4pp-v632", "https://github.com/librenms/librenms/releases/tag/26.7.0", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-7cj5-v4pp-v632"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/librenms/librenms/security-advisories/GHSA-7cj5-v4pp-v632", "severity": "medium", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/librenms/librenms", "summary": "LibreNMS: Stored XSS via graph_descr admin config settings echoed without escaping to all authenticated users", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-08-18T21:17:23Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-7cj5-v4pp-v632", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "26.7.0", "package": {"ecosystem": "composer", "name": "librenms/librenms"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "< 26.7.0"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
